content.value: . Consider a steam power plant operating on ideal reheat Rankine cycle. Steam enters the highpressure turbine at 15 MPa and 600°C and is condensed in the condenser at a pressure of 10 kPa. If the moisture content in the steam at the exit of the low-pressure turbine is not to be exceed 10.4%, determine (i) the pressure at which steam should be reheated, and (ii) the thermal efficiency of the cycle. Assume the steam is reheated to the inlet temperature of highpressure turbine.
